STREET', 'STREET' (N-S street west of Mt. Harrison, no name printed: recorded '?'). Names taken from neighbouring plates because only cut tabs appear here: Sperber Street and Clifford Street (plate 33), Queen City Avenue (old picks / plate 33), Elberon, Purcell, Considine and Hawthorne Avenues and Lehman Road (plate 29, same streets ~80 px west there); Thinnes Street from the old 22-31L reading (only '...ES' visible here). Geometry: the plate's west neat line runs along Quebec Avenue's west side, so Quebec crossings carry ~15 px. Margaret is 20 ft and runs ~N from Westwood to Lydia, then bends at Lydia into a 40 ft diagonal SSW that dead-ends at block 13 (~y 2000). Northside Avenue curves from Van Hart west and south to Jonte, then runs straight SSW (40 ft) to the subdivision line at y~3105. Jonte has two sections: west (Quebec to the 20 ft alley at x~957, centre ~2605-2612) and east (Northside to Grand, centre ~2580-2587). Schoedinger begins at Uerman (L-corner), crosses Jonte and runs SW to the plate edge; the N-S 'STREET' starts just east of its end, runs south along the plate edge, jogs east at y~5235 and runs south to Theresa and Liberty. Grand Avenue: 30 ft section from Jonte south to a dead end at y~4677; Tomlinson's corner at (2281,5271) begins the south section (50-60 ft) to Lehman and the plate edge. Not streets: subdivision lettering (SCHOEDINGER'S, GRAEBE'S, HERMANN, MT. HARRISON SUBDIV'N, ...'S SUB.), the orange/pink/blue/green/yellow boundary bands, the dashed sewer lines and the narrow double-line strip (lot (94)) between Quebec and Margaret at y~1440-1530, the dashed '22 in W. pipe' line through tract 30, the ~5 ft gore strip south of Margaret's end.
